text.description: What to say, and how. Bracketed directions and sounds are performed, not read: [barely holding it together] I'm fine. [small laugh] Paired tags shape specific words: <whisper>, <emphasis>, <soft>, <fast>, <slow>, <stress>, <forceful>. For dialogue, mark turns with <|speaker:0|>, <|speaker:1|>, ... matching the order of voice_ids.
text.title: Text

voice_ids.description: Fish Audio voice ids (from fish.audio). One id for a single voice; several for a dialogue, one per speaker tag in order. Empty: the model picks a voice.
voice_ids.title: Voice Ids

reference_audio.description: A clip of the voice to clone: 10 to 30 seconds of clear speech, WAV, MP3 or FLAC. Use it instead of voice_ids.
reference_audio.title: Reference Audio

reference_text.description: Exact transcript of reference_audio. Required with it.
reference_text.title: Reference Text

format.description: Audio format. pcm is raw 16-bit mono.
format.title: Format

sample_rate.description: Sample rate in Hz. Empty: 44100, or 48000 for opus. mp3 takes 32000 or 44100; opus only 48000.
sample_rate.title: Sample Rate

temperature.description: Sampling temperature, 0 to 1. Higher is more varied. Empty: Fish Audio's default.
temperature.title: Temperature

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling, 0 to 1. Empty: Fish Audio's default.
top_p.title: Top P

normalize.description: Normalize numbers and symbols in English and Chinese text before speaking.
normalize.title: Normalize

latency.description: normal for best quality; balanced and low trade quality for a faster start.
latency.title: Latency
